2609.01187.title: Athena: Vulnerability-Affected Library Identification via Knowledge Graph Completion
2609.01187.paper_summary: A single vulnerability in a widely used library can cascade through millions of dependent applications, yet more than half of vulnerability database entries contain missing or incorrect affected-library information. Existing automated approaches neglect the relational structure of vulnerability databases, treating identification as an isolated text retrieval problem. In this paper, we propose Athena, the first graph-based approach for vulnerability affected library identification. Athena models vulnerability databases as a knowledge graph and reformulates the identification problem as knowledge graph completion (KGC). It comprises three key modules: a Modeling module that constructs a security knowledge graph integrating CVEs, libraries, CWE weakness types, CPE products, and software ecosystems; a Completion module that applies a modular KGC backbone to predict missing affected libraries for a given CVE via link prediction; and a Re-ranking module that retrieves KGC candidates and rescores them using a fine-tuned LLM augmented with knowledge graph embeddings, jointly leveraging structural and textual information. Our experiments on VulLib demonstrate that Athena significantly outperforms four state-of-the-art baselines, achieving a 32% improvement in Avg. F1 over the best baseline (i.e., VulLibGen). Notably, our KGC backbone with only 110M parameters already surpasses VulLibGen's best configuration at 7B parameters, demonstrating the effectiveness of graph-based modeling; the re-ranking module then provides substantial further gains, consistently outperforming the best baseline across all evaluated LLM backbones.
2609.01187.paper_summary_zh: 一個在廣泛使用的庫中的單一漏洞可以通過數百萬個依賴應用程序進行級聯，然而超過一半的漏洞數據庫條目包含缺失或不正確的受影響庫信息。現有的自動化方法忽略了漏洞數據庫的關係結構，將識別視為一個孤立的文本檢索問題。在本文中，我們提出了Athena，這是第一個基於圖的漏洞受影響庫識別方法。Athena將漏洞數據庫建模為知識圖，並將識別問題重新表述為知識圖補全（KGC）。它包括三個關鍵模塊：一個建模模塊，構建一個整合CVE、庫、CWE弱點類型、CPE產品和軟件生態系統的安全知識圖；一個補全模塊，應用模塊化的KGC骨架通過鏈接預測來預測給定CVE的缺失受影響庫；以及一個重新排名模塊，檢索KGC候選者並使用經過微調的LLM重新評分，該LLM增強了知識圖嵌入，聯合利用結構和文本信息。我們在VulLib上的實驗表明，Athena顯著超越了四個最先進的基準，實現了相較於最佳基準（即VulLibGen）在平均F1上提高32%的效果。值得注意的是，我們的KGC骨架僅有1.1億個參數，已經超過了VulLibGen在70億參數下的最佳配置，展示了基於圖的建模的有效性；而重新排名模塊則提供了顯著的進一步增益，在所有評估的LLM骨架中持續超越最佳基準。
